articles.title: Joint venture of OKX and NYSE parent ICE files for 24/7 tokenized U.S. stock trading
articles.snippet: OKXICE, the joint venture of OKX and ICE, plans to launch tokenized U.S. stocks under SEC's new innovation exemption.

articles.title: OKX, NYSE parent file to launch tokenized US stock platform
articles.snippet: The stock trading platform seeks to offer tokenized shares in more than 60 US-listed companies under the SEC’s recently introduced innovation exemption.

articles.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

articles.title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
articles.snippet: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.

articles.title: OKX and NYSE Owner ICE Plan 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading Under SEC Exemption
articles.snippet: Filed under the SEC's new Innovation Exemption, the notice lists more than 60 stocks, including Nvidia and SpaceX, paired with stablecoins.
